description: This file contains functions for configuring command-line interface (CLI) options for a Software Radio (SDR) Radio Unit (RU) using CLI11 library. It defines various configuration functions for amplitude control, radio parameters, logging, CPU affinities, thread profiles, and overall schema setup, including parsing and default handling.

methods.name: configure_cli11_amplitude_control_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for amplitude control parameters such as gain backoff, clipping, and ceiling.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_sdr_expert_args
methods.description: Sets up CLI options for radio transmission mode, throttling, and power ramping in expert configuration.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_sdr_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for SDR radio parameters including sample rate, device, gain, frequency offsets, and expert settings.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Sets CLI options for logging levels.

methods.name: configure_cli11_cell_affinity_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for CPU affinity masks and policies for the radio unit.

methods.name: configure_cli11_lower_phy_threads_args
methods.description: Sets CLI options for lower physical layer thread profiles (single, dual, triple).

methods.name: configure_cli11_expert_execution_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for expert execution including thread and cell affinity settings.

methods.name: configure_cli11_metrics_args
methods.description: Sets CLI options for enabling radio unit metrics.

methods.name: configure_cli11_with_ru_sdr_config_schema
methods.description: Main function to set up CLI subcommands and options for the SDR radio unit configuration schema.

methods.name: autoderive_ru_sdr_parameters_after_parsing
methods.description: Post-processing function to adjust parsed configuration, setting default thread profile for ZMQ device driver and resizing cell affinities.
